Order_
This matter is taken up through hybrid mode.

Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned Addl.
 .
Standing Counsel for the State.

3. The petitioner is in custody being convicted for the offence under Sections 376/506 IPC and sentenced to undergo R.I. for a period of seven years and to pay a fine of Rs.2,000/- only, in its default, to undergo R.I. for two months for the offence punishable under Section 376 of IPC and further sentenced to undergo R.I. for one year for the offence punishable under Section 506 of IPC.
4.

Considering the evidence of the victim, who was examined as P.W.-5 during trial and in the absence of any clear cut evidence to show the commission of the sexual offence and the fact that the petitioner was on bail during trial as well as during appeal, I am inclined to allow the prayer for bail.

5. Let the petitioner be released on bail on such terms and conditions as the convicting court may deem fit and proper to impose.
6.
I.A. is disposed of.

7. Issue urgent certified copy as per rules.
